title: NTV Android TV v1.5
changelog:
• Performance Overhaul & Memory Caps: Bounded Go server RAM (GOMEMLIMIT=48MiB, GOGC=50) and 24-hour rolling EPG window saving ~50MB RAM.
• NuvioTV Optimizations: 50% image RAM reduction via RGB_565 & GPU hardware bitmaps; Compose Compiler Stability configuration for butter-smooth 60fps scrolling.
• Hardware-First Video Decoder Priority: Enforced hardware VPU decoders for 0% CPU overhead and zero frame drops.
• Network & DNS Upgrades: IPv4-first DNS sorting to eliminate ISP IPv6 timeouts, TCP_NODELAY on video streaming sockets, and 16-connection HTTP/2 pool.
• Akamai/Zee Channel Switching Fix: Solved 403 Forbidden stream error when zapping between Zee/ClearKey streams via strict ACL-scoped cookie validation.
• UI & Navigation Suite: Recent channels with instant recall, mini channel surfing banner, live number key dialing overlay, and quick aspect ratio toggle.
